text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said on Thursday its businesses continued to experience strong order and sales activity in the fourth quarter for original equipment and aftermarket support products and services.
The company today reported fiscal fourth quarter (ended October 31) net income per share of $0.41, after a $43 million pre-tax restructuring charge for Beloit Corp, versus $0.51 a year earlier.
"The company's increasingly strong operating results and bookings reflect ongoing strengths in our businesses on a global basis," Chairman Jeffrey Grade said in a statement.
"For the first time, each of our businesses generated positive 'economic value added' for our shareholders, which equates to at least 12 percent after tax on invested capital," Grade added.
Fourth-quarter net sales rose 16 percent to $712 million from $614 in the same 1995 period. Fourth-quarter bookings rose 30 percent, to $851 million, the company said.
Record net sales for the 1996 fiscal year of $2.86 billion were up 33 percent from 1995's $2.15 billion, it added.
Harnischfeger is an international holding company involved in making and distributing equipment for surface and underground mining, pulp and papermaking, and material handling.
Its shares were trading up 1-3/4 at 44-1/4.
